tools.name: genppt_account_status
tools.description: Show the connected GenPPT account: plan, decks used this period, saved card, and upgrade options.

tools.name: genppt_list_decks
tools.description: List the user’s GenPPT decks, newest edits first.

tools.name: genppt_get_deck
tools.description: Get one deck: its phase, concept preview, slides, and image URLs. Poll it after genppt_create_deck to follow progress.

tools.name: genppt_generate_slides
tools.description: Render the full slides once genppt_get_deck shows phase concepts_ready. Same as the Generate button in the studio. Slides take 1-3 minutes.

tools.name: genppt_create_deck
tools.description: Generate a new AI presentation deck from a prompt, notes, or URLs. Returns at once; slides render in 1-3 minutes. Uses one deck from the plan allowance.

tools.name: genppt_export_deck
tools.description: Export a ready deck to PowerPoint, PDF, or a ZIP of slide images. Waits until the file is built (up to 2 minutes) and returns a download URL. Paid plans only.

tools.name: genppt_upgrade_plan
tools.description: Preview the cost of a GenPPT plan. Never charges. Ask the user before passing confirmPaymentSpend: true; that returns the checkout link where the user pays.

tools.name: genppt_submit_feedback
tools.description: Send a bug report, feature request, or question to the GenPPT team.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: genppt_get_deck · Private data: genppt_export_deck · Public sink: genppt_submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: genppt_get_deck · Private data: genppt_export_deck · Public sink: genppt_submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
